mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Clavatustide B-treated human cancer cell lines
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Clavatustide B treatment increases the G1/S ratio in Panc-1, MGC-803, SW-480, WERI-Rb-1, and PC3 cells, supporting a cell-cycle-transition mechanism context.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports cell-cycle arrest context, not a direct molecular binding target.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Clavatustide B-treated HepG2 and validation cancer-cell systems

mechanism_claims.limitations: Expression-marker association is retained as mechanistic context; it is not normalized to a direct target-binding mechanism.
